theorem_statement: Work over a field k of characteristic zero. Let H denote the algebraic stack of pairs (C,gamma) with C a smooth proper geometrically connected genus-6 curve and gamma:C->P^1 finite flat of degree 4 whose Casnati-Ekedahl relations bundle is fibrewise balanced, F ~= O(4)+O(5), taken modulo the PGL_2 action on the target; let H^prim be the open substack of primitive gamma (gamma not factoring through a degree-2 map P^1->P^1). Let W_5 be the canonical degree-16 invertible quotient of the CE filtration 0->W_4->W->W_5->0 of ATT-0065/CLM-0065-5 (dual-confirmed REV-0108, REV-0109), put L=W_5 tensor omega^{-1} of fibrewise degree 6, and let I=Hilb^6(C/H) x_{Pic^6(C/H)} H be the closed Abel-Jacobi incidence of ATT-0066/CLM-0066-5 (dual-confirmed REV-0110, REV-0116), with I^dist its distinct-support open and tilde-I=Conf_6(C/H) x_{Hilb^6} I the ordered model, which by ATT-0066/CLM-0066-6 equals the CE evaluation-failure locus Z_ev scheme-theoretically. Then, ASSUMING ONLY the dependency package just cited and the fibrewise weak CE normalization hypothesis carried by ATT-0066 (FND-0105 form), the following hold, all statements being about algebraic stacks and none about coarse spaces. (A) DIMENSION AND SMOOTHNESS OF THE AMBIENT HURWITZ STACK. H is a smooth Deligne-Mumford stack, equidimensional of dimension 15, and its generic point has trivial automorphism group; more precisely the automorphism group of a point (C,gamma) of H is the finite group Aut(C,gamma)={sigma in Aut(C): there exists tau in PGL_2 with gamma o sigma = tau o gamma}, so H is a finite-stabilizer DM stack and dim H = 2g+2d-5 = 15 for (g,d)=(6,4). (B) STRATIFIED STRUCTURE OF THE FAILURE LOCUS OVER H. Write H=H_3 disjoint-union H_4 for the locally closed h^0(L)-strata of ATT-0066/CLM-0066-3, with H_4 closed and contained in the non-primitive hyperelliptic locus, so that H^prim is contained in H_3 and H_3 is open and dense in H if H^prim is dense. Over the reduced stratum H_k the incidence I|_{H_k} is a Zariski-locally trivial P^{k-1}-bundle, hence smooth over H_k of relative dimension k-1 and equidimensional of dimension 15+k-1; in particular I|_{H_3} is smooth of pure dimension 17 and I|_{H_4} has pure dimension 15+3-dim H_4 corrections given by dim H_4+3. Consequently I is equidimensional of dimension 17 over H_3 and every component of I dominating H is 17-dimensional, while any component of I lying over H_4 has dimension dim H_4+3 <= 14+3 = 17 whenever dim H_4 <= 14. (C) COMPONENTS AND IRREDUCIBILITY TRANSFER. The number of irreducible components of I|_{H_3} of dimension 17 equals the number of irreducible components of H_3, because a Zariski-locally trivial projective bundle over an irreducible base is irreducible and the P^2-bundle structure of (B) is a bijection between components of H_3 and components of I|_{H_3}. Hence irreducibility of I|_{H_3} is EQUIVALENT to irreducibility of H_3 and is not an independent geometric input; no irreducibility of H, H_3 or I is asserted here. (D) THE ORDERED COVER AND ITS STABILIZERS. On the distinct-support open, tilde-I -> I^dist is a finite etale S_6-torsor at stack level (ATT-0066/CLM-0066-6, FND-0064, FND-0075), so dim tilde-I = dim I^dist, the components of tilde-I are the S_6-orbits of components of I^dist together with their monodromy, and the automorphism group of a point of tilde-I lying over (C,gamma,Gamma) with Gamma=x_1+...+x_6 reduced is the pointwise stabilizer Aut(C,gamma,x_1,...,x_6)={sigma in Aut(C,gamma): sigma(x_i)=x_i for all i}. (E) STABILIZER TRIVIALITY AND THE FORGETFUL MAP TO M_{6,6}. For every point of tilde-I with Gamma reduced, Aut(C,gamma,x_1,...,x_6) is trivial. Indeed such a sigma fixes six distinct points of C and lies in the finite group Aut(C), and it induces tau in PGL_2 with gamma o sigma = tau o gamma; the six fixed points, being six distinct points of a genus-6 curve, force sigma=id as soon as sigma has more than 2g+2=14 fixed points OR, without any bound on fixed points, force sigma=id by the following argument used in the proof: sigma fixes Gamma pointwise and preserves L=O(Gamma), hence preserves omega_C(-D) and D up to linear equivalence, and the quotient C->C/<sigma> would have to be compatible with gamma; the full argument is given in the body and yields Aut(C,gamma,x_1,...,x_6)=1 only under the additional hypothesis that sigma acts trivially on the tetragonal pencil, which is proved when tau=id, and is NOT proved in general. Accordingly (E) is stated in the weaker proved form: the subgroup of Aut(C,gamma,x_1,...,x_6) acting trivially on P^1 (i.e. with tau=id) is trivial whenever the six points are not all contained in fibres permuted by sigma, and in particular tilde-I is a DM stack with finite stabilizers whose generic stabilizer is trivial on the primitive stratum. (F) THE MAP TO M_{6,6} IS NOT SHOWN TO BE A MONOMORPHISM. The forgetful 1-morphism u:tilde-I -> M_{6,6}, (C,gamma,x_1,...,x_6) |-> (C,x_1,...,x_6), is representable and quasi-finite ONLY MODULO the recovery of gamma from the marked data; by FND-0098 the fibre of u over (C,x_*) is the set of balanced tetragonal pencils gamma on C with O(sum x_i) ~= W_5(gamma) tensor omega^{-1}, and the identification L ~= omega_C(-D) supplied by the ATT-0066 normalization hypothesis recovers the pencil as |omega_C tensor L^{-1}|=|O_C(D)|, which is a g^1_4 containing D. Hence, GRANTING the ATT-0066 normalization hypothesis, u has finite fibres and its fibre over (C,x_*) injects into the set of degree-4 pencils contained in |omega_C(-Gamma)|^vee-recovery, so dim u(tilde-I) = dim tilde-I = 17 and the image of u has dimension 17, i.e. codimension 4 in the 21-dimensional M_{6,6}; but u is NOT proved to be a monomorphism, and no purity, closedness, or lci property of the image is claimed. (G) NON-PURITY AND NON-CLOSEDNESS ARE NOT ESTABLISHED. Consistently with FND-0067 and FND-0101, this theorem asserts neither that the balanced image Z^{bal} is closed in M_{6,6} nor that it fails to be closed; no witness closure point is exhibited, and the codimension-4 statement of (F) is a statement about the constructible image of u and its dimension only.
